item.title: Hévíz Lake Bath redevelopment: iconic bathhouse faces demolition plans
item.description: The world's largest thermal lake. A major redesign could reshape Hévíz Lake Bath. Would you visit during the works?

item.title: FM Sikorski: Hungary directly harms Poland’s security interests
item.description: Poland’s FM says Hungary is blocking EU decisions on Russia sanctions and Ukraine military funding — and harming Poland’s security.

item.title: Orbán’s speech in parliament: debate on Ukraine, Russian energy sources instead of American ones, EU vetoes and domestic measures
item.description: PM Orbán: Hungary will not give in to the Americans (for example Shell) and will continue to rely on Russian energy sources; strategic oil reserves have been opened key points here.

item.title: Attention: Wizz Air suspends bookings and online check-in for one night this week
item.description: Wizz Air will temporarily suspend access to its booking and digital customer service systems for one night this week. Here are the details.

item.title: It’s decided! EU sanctions blocked as Hungary and Slovakia refuse to back the 20th Russia sanctions package – UPDATE
item.description: Russia and Putin can breathe a sigh of relief! The Hungarian right-wing and Slovak socialist governments have vetoed the new sanctions.

item.title: 48 Days to the election: Péter Magyar on democracy, campaign plans, and threats – interview
item.description: Péter Magyar, leader of the Tisza Party, reveals election strategy and government plans for 2026. Here are the key points.

item.title: Mystery of missing 18-year-old in central Budapest is resolved — but in the worst possible way
item.description: Tragic update: the missing 18-year-old in Budapest has been found dead. Police say the body was recovered. Read the details.

item.title: Hungary news: teen tragedy, Wizz Air alert, sanctions standoff

item.title: Hungary Parliamentary elections 2026: Ukrainians registered first to draw up a national minority list
item.description: Does this mean the Ukrainian minority will have representation in Hungarian Parliament?

item.title: Billion-euro airport expansion begins in Budapest with Terminal+ project
item.description: A major expansion has begun at Budapest Ferenc Liszt International Airport, where the cornerstone of the new Terminal+ complex has been laid. The project could become one of Hungary’s largest transport investments in the coming years.
